items.banner: The Zn VASP model for ZnCl₂ solutions is now available.
items.details: The Zn K-edge XANES VASP model is now available in the web interface. It was trained on aqueous ZnCl₂ solutions and applies only to those solutions ([paper]).

items.banner: The Ti K-edge XANES benchmark paper is on [paper].
items.details: The Ti K-edge XANES benchmark paper is on arXiv ([paper]). It evaluates key physical effects in the simulations and compares simulated spectra with experimental data. It describes how the Ti VASP model accounts for many-body shake-up effects.
